home.subtitle: A city of stories. A sea of possibilities.
home.intro: Saida and Cordoba have been designated the Mediterranean Capitals of Culture and Dialogue for 2027. In Saida, the programme, Threads of the Sea, connects the city's maritime heritage and diverse cultural life with ideas for its future. Through cultural events, community initiatives and exchange across the Mediterranean, MCCD Saida 2027 will invite residents, artists, organizations and visitors to take part in a shared year of culture, creativity and dialogue.
home.scroll: A shared year of culture, creativity & dialogue
home.upcomingText: Gather by the water. Wander through history. Make something new.
home.themeTitle:
Rooted in Saida.
Open to the world.
home.themeIntro: Three strands, woven into one shared year. Our maritime past, our living culture and the possibilities ahead.
home.strand1Text: The sea that shaped our city: its crafts, stories, journeys and enduring connections.
home.strand2Text: The voices of Saida today, from courtyard performances to conversations across generations.
home.strand3Text: A space for young people, new collaborations and a more connected Mediterranean.
home.citiesText: From the shores of Lebanon to the courtyards of Andalusia, two cities share the 2027 designation. Together, they open a conversation across a sea that connects us.
home.ctaTitle:
Every story adds
a new thread.
home.ctaText: An exhibition, a performance, a neighbourhood gathering. Bring your idea to Saida’s year of culture and dialogue.

about.title:
A shared sea.
A shared story.
about.intro: Culture brings us into conversation. In 2027, Saida invites the Mediterranean to join in.
about.initiativeText: Mediterranean Capitals of Culture and Dialogue is jointly coordinated by the Union for the Mediterranean and the Anna Lindh Foundation. The initiative celebrates cultural diversity and dialogue across the region.
about.designationText: Saida, Lebanon, and Córdoba, Spain, share the designation for 2027. Their programmes create opportunities for cultural exchange, community participation and new connections.
about.themeText: Saida’s programme connects the city’s maritime heritage and diverse cultural life with ideas for its future. Its three strands invite residents, artists, cultural organisations and visitors to shape a shared year.
about.regionalRole: Coordinates the Mediterranean Capitals of Culture and Dialogue across the region.
about.hostRole: Hosts the year’s programme across its venues, streets and shoreline.
about.committee: MCCD Saida 2027 organising committee — official name to be confirmed
about.cordobaText: Across the Mediterranean, Córdoba brings another perspective to the same conversation. Both cities share a commitment to culture as a meeting place.
about.creditsText: The photographs of Saida on this preview are by Wikimedia Commons contributors and are used under the licences listed. Approved programme photography will replace them before launch.

legal.privacy1: The form asks for event information, your name, organisation, email and phone number. Event details, organiser name and organisation are intended for publication. Your email and phone number are private coordination information.
legal.privacy2: Drafts and sample reservations are saved in this browser’s local storage. They are not sent to a database or by email. Attachments are not uploaded or retained. Anyone using the same browser profile may be able to access these drafts and records. Use sample information while reviewing this site.
legal.privacy3: Use “Clear draft” in the submission form to remove an unfinished draft. Use “Reset demo data” in the demonstration admin area to remove local reservations and edits. Clearing this site’s browser storage removes all preview data.
legal.privacy4: The official data controller, contact address, retention period and procedure for access, correction or deletion requests must be confirmed and added here. The production service will require secure storage and restricted access for authorised programme staff.
legal.accessTitle: Culture should be open to everyone.
legal.access1: This site is designed for keyboard navigation, screen readers, readable contrast and both left-to-right English and right-to-left Arabic. Motion follows your device’s reduced-motion preference.
legal.access2: Use the skip link to reach the main content. Calendars support arrow keys; Enter selects an available date. Booked dates and slots are labelled in text and cannot be selected. Forms identify errors beside the relevant fields.
legal.access3: Venue accessibility information is shown on each event page and must be confirmed by organisers before publication. Please contact the programme team once the official contact channel is available if you need information in another format.
legal.access4: The site targets WCAG 2.1 AA. A final independent accessibility audit is required before launch.

e1.title: An evening by the sea
e1.description: A sample opening gathering on the Sea Castle esplanade, bringing live music and stories of the coast into conversation. Meet local performers and neighbours as the light changes over the harbour. Programme details and participating artists will be confirmed before launch.
e1.access: Outdoor paved esplanade. Step-free arrival and accessible seating to be confirmed with the organiser.

e2.title: The city, one story at a time
e2.description: A sample guided walk through the Old City, pausing at courtyards, markets and shared spaces to hear the stories that connect generations. The final route, meeting point and guide will be confirmed.
e2.access: Uneven paving and narrow passages on the proposed route. An accessible route and rest stops are to be confirmed.

e3.title: Woven together
e3.description: A sample hands-on workshop exploring thread, pattern and the craft traditions of the Mediterranean. Participants will create a small collaborative piece inspired by the sea. Materials, age guidance and facilitation will be confirmed.
e3.access: Ground-floor workshop proposed. Step-free entry, table heights and accessible toilets to be confirmed.

e4.title: Courtyard conversations
e4.description: A sample dialogue on the future of Mediterranean cities, with space for young voices, shared experience and new ideas. The panel, interpretation and programme will be confirmed by the organising team.
e4.access: Seated event. Step-free access and interpretation provision to be confirmed.

e5.title: Rooms of memory
e5.description: A sample exhibition reflecting on everyday life, domestic objects and the memories carried by Saida’s historic houses. The final curatorial approach and any ticket arrangements require approval.
e5.access: Historic building with stairs and limited lift access. Accessible alternatives and a detailed access guide are to be confirmed.

e6.title: Sounds across the water
e6.description: A sample courtyard performance exploring musical connections across the Mediterranean. The programme, performers and admission arrangements will be announced after confirmation.
e6.access: Seated courtyard performance. Step-free entry and reserved accessible seating to be confirmed.

e7.title: Small hands, shared futures
e7.description: A sample family workshop where children and adults imagine the city they would like to share. Drawing, making and storytelling bring those ideas together. Participation guidance will be confirmed.
e7.access: Family seating and quiet break space proposed. Facilities and step-free access to be confirmed.

e8.title: From Saida to Córdoba
e8.description: A sample conversation connecting the two designated capitals through culture, memory and ideas for the future. Contributors and language support are subject to final approval.
e8.access: Seated conversation. Accessible entry, hearing support and interpretation to be confirmed.

e9.title: The sea we share
e9.description: A sample open-air gathering to reflect on the coast as a shared place. Art, conversation and collective making invite visitors to think about its future. The final programme will be confirmed.
e9.access: Outdoor event. Level access routes, seating and accessible facilities to be confirmed.

n1.title: A year of culture, woven together
n1.body:
Saida’s 2027 programme takes its name from the sea that has shaped the city. Threads of the Sea brings maritime heritage, cultural life and ideas for the future into a shared conversation.

This sample announcement introduces the proposed website programme. It is an invitation to explore how events, community initiatives and Mediterranean exchange can connect people across the city.

The final calendar, participating organisations and official announcements will be published after approval by the Saida team.

n2.title: Your idea belongs in the programme
n2.body:
An exhibition, a workshop or a gathering in a familiar courtyard: culture takes many forms. The event submission flow offers a place for organisations to describe an idea and explore available dates.

In this preview, reservations are demonstration records saved only in your browser. The team will confirm booking rules, publication arrangements and organiser guidance before the public launch.

n3.title: Two cities, a Mediterranean conversation
n3.body:
Saida and Córdoba share the designation as Mediterranean Capitals of Culture and Dialogue for 2027. Their connection creates space for exchange across distinct histories and living cultures.

This sample story illustrates how the website will share news of that relationship. Specific exchanges, participating artists and dates remain to be confirmed.
